title: Offer Cards
style: A social-native offer reel: dark plan cards (price, three included items, a button) fan in, compare side by side, and one lifts forward; a plus sign joins a setup fee and a monthly fee; the reel ends on a big 'Comment "hour"' call to action with a pulsing reply bubble. Rich card shadows, confident type. Captions are serif word ladders (kit captions.ts): short stacks of mixed sizes, one key word in the accent italic, set beside the action and arriving word by word.
learnsFrom: Founder explainer reels (Instagram, @gregisenberg's team): pricing cards that fan in and compare, a setup fee plus a monthly fee, a 'Comment "Agent"' ending.

story.what: hook: caption 'How do you get paid?' in a ladder
two plan cards fan in: 'Solo · $0' and 'Team · $8 / seat'; features tick on
the Team card lifts forward; a '+' joins a small 'setup · $0' card; caption 'no setup, cancel anytime'
a third card flips in: 'Pay per booking · $0.50' for occasional users
all cards stack and slide away; a reply bubble types 'hour'
CTA: 'Comment "hour" for the guide' with the bubble pulsing; 'Oriel · a fictional product' small

sizes: Portrait (4:5) fits two cards side by side at a smaller scale and keeps the CTA in the lower third.
sound: beatScore soft at 120 bpm with a card-slide whoosh for each card, ticks on features, and a hit on the CTA.
teaches: An offer is a stack of objects the viewer can compare: animate the comparison, then end on one clear action.

portable.fonts: Inter (400, 600, 800) for cards, Instrument Serif and Instrument Serif Italic for captions
